title: Key interrupted by a literal line feed in plain text
summary: A line feed sits inside the key in a text file with no construct that joins the lines.
rationale: Nothing rebuilds the original: the text holds two fragments and a separator, which is not the documented key grammar.

expectation.rationale: Project policy of this example: whitespace inserted into a value is not stripped; the joined text is not asserted to be a credential.

notes: Worked example for the representation guide (ADR 0016). Synthetic; the policy stated here is an example, not a claim about any product.
